Both of the authors are supported by NSFC (Nos.11671174, 12171207).
arxiv-2112-00310.creator: Zhi-Wei Li, Xiaojin Zhang ∗
arxiv-2112-00310.description: Abstract . We study (support) τ \tau -tilting modules over the trivial extensions of finite dimensional algebras. More precisely, we construct two classes of (support) τ \tau -tilting modules in terms of the adjoint functors which extend and generalize the results on (support) τ \tau -tilting modules over triangular matrix rings given by Gao-Huang. \SelectTips cm 1.

arxiv-2306-01446.title: Chiral Anomaly Beyond Fermionic Paradigm
arxiv-2306-01446.creator: Tianyu Liu, Zheng Shi, Hai-Zhou Lu, X. C. Xie
arxiv-2306-01446.description: Abstract Two-dimensional magnets have manifested themselves as promising candidates for quantum devices. We here report that the edge and strain effects during the device fabrication with two-dimensional honeycomb ferromagnets such as CrX 3 (X=Cl, I, Br) and CrXTe 3 (X=Si, Ge) can be characterized by a (1+1)-dimensional magnon chiral anomaly beyond the fermionic paradigm.

arxiv-2405-15586.title: DAGER: Exact Gradient Inversion for Large Language Models
arxiv-2405-15586.creator: Ivo Petrov, Dimitar I. Dimitrov, Maximilian Baader, Mark Niklas Müller, Martin Vechev, {ivo.petrov, dimitar.iliev.dimitrov}@insait.ai, {mbaader, mark.mueller, martin.vechev}@inf.ethz.ch
arxiv-2405-15586.description: Abstract Federated learning works by aggregating locally computed gradients from multiple clients, thus enabling collaborative training without sharing private client data. However, prior work has shown that the data can actually be recovered by the server using so-called gradient inversion attacks.

arxiv-2506-03873.title: Electrically-induced resonance shifts of whispering gallery resonators made of barium magnesium fluoride
arxiv-2506-03873.creator: Alexander Mrokon, Heike Kraft, Dongsung Shin, Hiroki Tanaka, Simon J. Herr, Karsten Buse, Ingo Breunig
arxiv-2506-03873.description: Abstract Barium magnesium fluoride (BMF) is a ferroelectric crystal with a transparency range far beyond the one of other optical materials. In particular, its low loss in the deep ultraviolet makes this material an unique candidate for frequency conversion in this spectral range.

arxiv-2510-24787.title: ESCA: Enabling Seamless Codec Avatar Execution through Algorithm and Hardware Co-Optimization for Virtual Reality
arxiv-2510-24787.creator: Mingzhi Zhu, Ding Shang, Sai Qian Zhang
arxiv-2510-24787.description: Abstract Photorealistic Codec Avatars (PCA), which generate high-fidelity human face renderings, are increasingly being used in Virtual Reality (VR) environments to enable immersive communication and interaction through deep learning–based generative models. However, these models impose significant computational demands, making real-time inference challenging on resource-constrained VR devices such as head-mounted displays (HMDs), where latency and power efficiency are critical.

pmc-10570329.title: Development and validation of a prediction model for iron status in a large U.S. cohort of women
pmc-10570329.creator: Ann Von Holle, Katie M O’Brien, Robert Janicek, Clarice R Weinberg
pmc-10570329.description: Serum iron levels can be important contributors to health outcomes, but it is not often feasible to rely on blood-based measures for a large epidemiologic study. Predictive models that use questionnaire-based factors such as diet, supplement use, recency of blood donation, and medical conditions could potentially provide a noninvasive alternative for studying health effects associated with iron status.

pmc-13334760.title: Synchronous Presentation of Intraperitoneal and Retroperitoneal Dedifferentiated Liposarcoma: A Case Report
pmc-13334760.creator: Yousra Mhande, Laila Merghat, Amal Hajri, Driss Erguibi, Saad Rifki El Jai
pmc-13334760.description: Liposarcomas (LPS) are a group of tumors with different subtypes, some of which are more aggressive. They most often arise in the retroperitoneum, while occurrence within the peritoneal cavity is uncommon. Symptoms are usually nonspecific. We report the case of a combined intraperitoneal and retroperitoneal dedifferentiated LPS (DDLPS), which presented significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges.

pmc-13418631.title: Modification of navigated S2–alar iliac minimally invasive pelvic fixation to facilitate ease of rod passage
pmc-13418631.creator: Ali Moghaddamjou, Nina Yoh, Nathan Winans, Andrew Chan, Praveen V. Mummaneni, Dean Chou
pmc-13418631.description: Rod alignment in minimally invasive spine (MIS) pelvic fixation using a traditional S2–alar iliac (S2-AI) starting point can be challenging, often requiring substantial rod contouring because of the medial to lateral angulation of the S2-AI tulip relative to the S1 screw.

pmc-13477162.title: Progressive Human Orf Virus Infection in a Kidney Transplant Recipient Successfully Treated with Cryotherapy Without Modification of Immunosuppression: A Case Report
pmc-13477162.creator: Samreen M Rahmoon, Leen M AbuAfifeh, Osama A Alkhalidi, Farooq Ahmad, Gamal B S Alfitori
pmc-13477162.description: Human orf is a zoonotic parapoxvirus infection that is typically self-limiting with resolution in 3–6 weeks but may cause severe disease in immunocompromised patients. We report a kidney transplant recipient who developed a rapidly progressive fingertip lesion following contact with raw meat during Eid al-Adha. Initial misdiagnosis and surgical excision were followed by marked lesion progression, mimicking a vascular tumor.
